newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigeria to settle 5.0 billion naira of local debt.
newsitem.headline: Nigeria to settle 5.0 billion naira of local debt.

text.p: By the third quarter of 1996 Nigeria's military government will settle 5.0 billion naira from debts to local contractors of 13.1 billion naira, finance minister Anthony Ani said on Thursday.
He said another 14.6 billion naira was owed for projects that are still ongoing. He did not mention when these debts would be repayed.

"In making payments, all debts below five million naira will be settled, whereas for debts over this amount, the first five million naira will be paid. The unpaid balances will be settled on pro-rata basis," Ani said.
He said the government was considering issuing redeemable stocks and certificates in respect of unpaid debts after exhausting the five billion naira earmarked.
For official transactions the government uses an exchange rate of $1=20 naira, but for all other transactions the open market rate of $1=80 naira is used.
